comments.text: I would like to take this precious moment to thank you and your team for the great and fabulous efforts you took to bringing out this country/island from darkness into light for me and other  viewers. I have been viewing many of your posts on YouTube and kindly keep the good work going for many of us cannot visit many countries/islands we are looking at for one or more reasons. Thank you! I am LP Hari from USA. 10/11/2026.
